logo.description: SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP shown on the intro and outro cards

mask.description: CSS selectors (not Playwright selectors) of elements to blur in the recording

mock.description: Answer matching network requests with canned responses; the first match wins

url.description: Playwright URL glob of the requests to answer, e.g. **/api/reports*

method.description: Only answer this HTTP method; others go to the network

clock.description: Start the page clock at this ISO date-time; it then runs normally

before.description: Run before every check and record, e.g. to reset demo data

run.description: Shell command, run in the script folder

after.description: Run after every check and record, even when it failed

caption.description: Caption shown while this step plays

hold.description: Extra real-time ms after the step

say.description: Narration spoken from the start of this step; the video waits for it before the next narrated step

chrome.description: Frame the recording in a browser window with an address bar, or show the bare viewport

address.description: Address-bar text; defaults to the app URL without its scheme

engine.description: system: macOS say / Linux espeak-ng; openai and elevenlabs read OPENAI_API_KEY / ELEVENLABS_API_KEY

name.description: Voice name (system, openai) or voice id (elevenlabs)

model.description: openai: gpt-4o-mini-tts by default; elevenlabs: eleven_multilingual_v2

instructions.description: openai only: how to speak, e.g. "warm and confident"

command.description: command engine: shell command that reads the text on stdin and writes audio to {out}

music.description: Music bed under the whole video; ducks while the voice speaks

file.description: Audio file, relative to the file that names it

subtitles.description: Narration subtitles: an .srt next to the video (file), also drawn on the video (burn), or none
